items.name: Secret scan
items.description: Scan staged changes, a branch diff or the whole repo for leaked secrets and forbidden files before committing.

items.name: Integration test scenario
items.description: Create or extend integration-test scenarios and test-case specs under tests/IT/senarios in the 4PM layout.

items.name: Progress report
items.description: Write a fact-based daily or date-range progress report into reports/ from git activity and the 4PM done book.

items.name: Code reviewer
items.description: Read-only reviewer that verifies and ranks correctness and security findings in a diff, branch or PR.

items.name: Prune merged branches
items.description: Delete local git branches already merged into the base branch (dry run by default).

items.name: Prune merged branches (VS Code tasks)
items.description: VS Code tasks to list or delete local branches already merged into the base branch.
